Sneaking restores the vanilla precise selection outline.

dds-tweak.config.visual.comment.compactS: Show each active status effect in its own 24×24 compact frame, six per column. Effects above level I show a small level badge. Hover one frame to expand only that effect using the vanilla inventory effect row while every other effect stays compact; compact ordering matches the vanilla expanded list. Hold Tab to expand the full vanilla list.

dds-tweak.config.tweaks.comment.clickThr: Smart redirects item frames only when the client can safely predict a meaningful support-block interaction; uncertain server-defined or stateful cases keep the frame interaction. Always restores the original behavior and redirects every item-frame click to its support block.
